conclusion.supported: In this fixed-torso,gravity-biased Teacher/passivek20 spring fixture and simulated20kg free cargo+7.815kg cart, unchanged mouth provides5.18s bilateral retention and ordinary contact-mediated short pull. No magnetic/pose binding needed.
not_supported: Free whole-robot backward/stop or20kg task qualification
TPUinterior-clamping force equal to whole-bill normal-force sum
Mouth hardware upgrade or groove requirement
conclusion.path_issue: Current executed approach is demonstrably not collision-free: upper-bill/shaft contact before rod capture, followed by~20mm rod depression and~10.13mm cart push before bilateral capture. Initial clear pose and sampledIK alone cannot clear the path. This proves the executed route is deficient; it does not prove every reachable route is blocked or that mouth/shaft geometry must change.
conclusion.counterfactual_limit: Trials3/4 use same adaptive rules with different jaw intervention. Their worldpaths/state distributions differ, so do not subtract displacement to claim a pure fixed-trajectory hardware effect. Independent observed rod traction plus reduced/no lower contact in4 still provides useful local evidence.
conclusion.minimum_next_question: Keep mouth shape. First resolve the already observed shaft approach collision using the existing geometry full-path clearance check ordered byPM. If a clear ingress is available, test that bounded ingress/close/pull under matched declared fixture and retain the open-jaw comparison; only persistent geometry conflict or demonstrated grip-limited failure can motivate a specific hardware alteration.
conclusion.timing: Forces/contact midpoints and owner body transforms all come from exact same prestate before integration; native pad proxy surface points reconstructed using midpoint±signed_distance*normal/2. This corrects005poststate mismatch.
conclusion.numerical_limit: Trial3meaningful hold beak pin residual46.1um and penetration415.4um; release pin residual1.778mm is separately not qualified. Centre migration15.1mm is not integrated material tangential slip.
conclusion.frozen_scope: Original04 and004unchanged; scene explicitly adds localtorso weld,free20kg cargo,wheel frictionloss and passive spring. Gravitybias changes commanded target only within original torque-speed/350Wlimits; no online realqpos overwrite is found.
